meta.title: AI Business Doctor
meta.description: A standing AI executive advisor for SMEs — detect, diagnose, predict, and recommend.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Enter your organization — every figure stays inside your tenant.

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: A fresh empty organization. Demo data is never copied.
signup.name: Your name
signup.passwordHint: At least eight characters. You are the only owner until you invite a team.
signup.error: Could not create the account. Check the fields and try again.
signup.exists: This email is already registered. Sign in instead.
signup.loginAfter: Account created. Automatic sign-in failed — please sign in.

onboarding.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.profileLead: This appears on briefings and settings. Currency defaults to SAR.
onboarding.name: Organization name
onboarding.sourcesTitle: What do you want to connect?
onboarding.sourcesLead: Pick sources. Uploads work today. Direct Salla, WhatsApp, and Meta linking is next.
onboarding.connectLead: After setup you land on the command center. With no upload you will see a clear empty state.
onboarding.comingSoon: {provider} linking is coming — use a file upload when available.
onboarding.uploadHint: Upload CSV or Excel after you finish setup.
onboarding.manualHint: You can enter KPIs by hand from Data sources.
onboarding.noneSelected: No source selected. You can skip and upload later.
onboarding.skipNote: Skipping takes you to an empty board until the first ingest arrives.
onboarding.error: Could not save setup. Complete name and city, then try again.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.lead: Name, city, currency, and sector — scoped to your tenant only.
settings.name: Name
settings.inviteLead: Member invites will open later. The owner role is fully working today.

empty.connectCta: Connect a source or upload a file
empty.dashboardTitle: The command center is waiting for your data
empty.dashboardBody: No data yet. Upload sales, expenses, customers, inventory, campaigns, or staff — or enter a single day — so this board runs on your organization only.
empty.briefingTitle: No briefing before the first number
empty.briefingBody: The briefing is built from your metrics: detect → diagnose → predict → recommend. Upload sales to generate the first morning.
empty.healthBody: The six pillars are computed from revenue, cost, cash, stock, customers, and marketing. Start with a sales file.
empty.insightsBody: After ingest we regenerate insights from your current numbers — never by copying the demo story.
empty.actionsBody: Tasks are generated from diagnosis. Ingest data first, then come back to act and measure.
empty.simulatorBody: What-if runs on your revenue and cost. Upload sales, then test the decision before you spend the week on it.

landing.headline: Your AI executive physician — on your organization's data, not a canned demo
landing.subhead: Create an account, connect sources or upload a file, then read a morning briefing built from your numbers: detect, diagnose, predict, recommend, act, measure. Every organization is isolated.
landing.trust: Built for the Saudi market — Arabic first, SAR by default, and each tenant's data never leaves its account.
landing.pipelineLead: Not a BI dashboard. An operating room for the CEO.
landing.featuresTitle: What the owner sees every morning
landing.pricingLead: Start with diagnosis. Billing is marketing-only in this release — no card required today.
landing.ctaBand: Create your organization, or open the Al-Noor story for four minutes.
landing.ctaBandLead: Sign-up opens an empty tenant. The demo is an optional, separate path.

feature.briefing: A morning note with five ranked items — urgent, opportunity, risk, growth, recommendation — from your own data.
feature.health: One 0–100 score with six explainable pillars. With no data you see a clear empty state.
feature.insights: Each finding walks Detect → Diagnose → Predict → Recommend and names the SAR effect.
feature.simulator: Ask what happens if you raise prices or cut ads — on your figures, not someone else's.

detect.title: Detect
detect.body: Daily drift in conversion, cost, cash, and stock.

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.body: A root cause in business language, not report language.

predict.title: Predict
predict.body: The SAR impact if the path runs another thirty days.

recommend.title: Recommend
recommend.body: One clear decision that can be executed this week.

act.title: Act
act.body: Traceable work inside the action center.

measure.title: Measure
measure.body: Before and after: did conversion return? Did cash recover?

starter.name: Starter
starter.desc: One organization, a daily briefing, and a health score.

growth.name: Growth
growth.desc: Deep diagnosis, the simulator, and the action center.

health.title: Business health score
health.lead: One explainable score. Select a pillar to see its drivers.

briefing.mockNote: AI layer is on the deterministic mock — set OPENAI_API_KEY for the live model.

insights.title: Insights engine
insights.lead: Detect → Diagnose → Predict → Recommend. Every finding carries a SAR effect.

simulator.title: What-if simulator
simulator.lead: Test the decision before you pay for it. The model is metric-bound to your tenant and ready for a real LLM layer later.

actions.title: Action center
actions.lead: Recommendations become tasks. Execution is judged by measured outcome, not a checkbox.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.lead: Upload CSV or Excel, or enter daily KPIs. Direct connectors (Salla, WhatsApp, Meta, banks) are framed — OAuth ships later.
sources.note: A mock toggle is no longer enough: uploads write rows into your tenant models. Connector secrets are encrypted when present; real OAuth is the next phase.
sources.manualLead: If a spreadsheet is too much today, enter a single day: revenue, orders, expenses, cash.
sources.uploadLead: Upload CSV or Excel, review columns, then confirm the import into your organization only.
sources.chooseOrDrop: Choose a CSV or Excel file, or drop it here.
sources.previewNote: {count} rows in {file}. Review the mapping, then confirm.
sources.parseError: Could not read the file. Use CSV or Excel with a header row.
sources.importError: Import failed. Check the required columns.
sources.oauthSoon: {provider} OAuth is not enabled in this release.
